content: 1. Document all medications the patient is currently taking, including their dosages and frequency, as well as any recent changes to their medication regimen. 2. Record any vaccinations the patient has received, particularly those relevant to diabetes management, such as the influenza vaccine, pneumococcal vaccine, and hepatitis B vaccine. 3. Follow the guidelines and recommendations provided by the American Diabetes Association (ADA) when assessing and managing the patient’s treatment plan. 4. Inquire about and document any use of complementary or alternative medicine therapies, including herbal supplements, acupuncture, or other non-conventional treatments, as these may interact with standard diabetes care or medications.
